topic: Software factories and execution trace analysis

parts.title: Execution traces in software factories
parts.reason: Luciq Bits (0:24–3:27) covers 3 min; slides cover missing context on coding agents, iterative loops, and software factories.

parts.title: Log structure and iteration markers
parts.reason: No video stretch; slides explain standardized log formats, iteration markers, and tool calls for navigating 2000-line logs.

parts.title: Typical failure patterns in agent traces
parts.reason: No video available; slides detail three recurring agent failure categories including environment misconfiguration and logic regressions.

parts.title: Trace collection and parsing tooling
parts.reason: No video stretch; slides present the demonstration of trace collection tools, log aggregator, and Python JSON log parser.

parts.title: Worked example: environment misconfiguration
parts.reason: In-class hands-on analysis allows step-by-step tracing of 500-line logs to locate missing environment variables and error codes.

alternative.reason: Taught live: no checked video teaches it.

parts.title: Worked example: dependency resolution failure
parts.reason: In-class work lets students actively trace version conflicts across iterations and extract specific dependency graph lines.

alternative.reason: Taught live: no checked video teaches it; the sources lack version conflict, dependency graph, iteration diff.

parts.title: Worked example: logic regression detection
parts.reason: In-class activity enables comparing successive iteration outputs to spot behavioral changes and commit diff lines.

alternative.reason: Taught live: no checked video teaches it; the sources lack behavioral change, test result diff, commit diff.

parts.title: Comparing failure causes across traces
parts.reason: No video stretch; slides present a side-by-side comparison matrix and severity ranking rubric for failure signatures.

parts.title: Activity: analyze full 2000‑line log
parts.reason: Pair activity engages students in running the parsing script on a 2000-line log to identify failure causes.

alternative.reason: Taught live: no checked video teaches it; the sources lack pair work, 2000‑line log, parsing script.

parts.title: Discussion: reporting and best practices
parts.reason: In-class discussion lets student pairs present trace findings, critique evidence, and outline automated detection checklists.
